summary: Iteration 32 — Service-level commission_percent + commissions report filters. 14/14 backend pytest cases pass; frontend Comissoes page renders fully on desktop & mobile with working filters/views. Service modal exposes 'Comissao deste servico/produto' field with svc-commission testid.

minor.issue: update_service strips fields with value=None (filter `if v is not None`), so it is impossible to clear an existing commission_percent back to None via API. Use 0 as workaround or change filter to use exclude_unset only.

action_items: (minor) Allow clearing service.commission_percent via PUT — currently None is dropped because update_service filters with `if v is not None`. Consider sending explicit null/empty string sentinel or relaxing the filter.
critical_code_review_comments: reports_routes.get_commissions_report — date filter relies on string compare against 'YYYY-MM-DD' which is correct only if appointment.date is stored as ISO string (verified in seed). OK.
reports_routes — service-level commission_percent correctly overrides professional, fallback works. Computation matches spec (svc=50% on R$100 -> R$50; fallback prof=30% on R$100 -> R$30).
Dashboard.ComissoesPage — CompactStat values use whitespace-nowrap+truncate, mobile rendering verified single-line on 390x844 (text 'R$ 180.00', height 20px, no newline).

All required data-testids are present: comissoes-page, commissions-filter-toggle, commissions-filters, filter-{start-date,end-date,professional,type,service}, apply-filters-btn, view-{professionals,items}, stat-{revenue,commission,appointments,avg-ticket}, svc-commission.
